messages.author: 1f498882cd4d3565
messages.subject: 502 Bad Gateway Error
parts:
When I try to deploy an app I am getting a 502 Bad Gateway error when attempting to upload the application bundle. I have successfully deployed a different app today but this one is causing problems. I have even tried re-naming the app so that it is a fresh deployment rather than updating an old app but am still unable to upload the bundle and deploy the app. I'm not sure what else to try or what might be causing the problem. Any advice would be appreciated.
Thank you!
